meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: Runs rigorous visual QA across web, terminal, and paginated surfaces with screenshot evidence and a verdict. Use for any UI build or change, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 跑一次视觉核对,用截图确认界面改动是否正常。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次改完界面都要靠肉眼反复确认有没有走样。
copy.tagline_en: Check any UI change with screenshots and get a clear pass-or-fail verdict.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep eyeballing every UI change to make sure nothing broke.

howto.what: 构建或改动界面后,它会截图取证,并行派两个只读评审子代理检查,再给出一个 good/bad 判定。覆盖网页、终端 TUI 和分页文档。
howto.when: 任何界面构建或改动之后、在宣布完成之前触发;被问某页面、组件或 TUI 是否正常时也触发。无渲染输出的纯后端逻辑不适用。

say.text: 帮我检查这个页面渲染得对不对,给出截图证据和判定
say.note: 会截图取证并派两个只读评审子代理,最后给判定

say.text: 拿 mock 图对照跑一遍这个组件的视觉 QA
say.note: 会把实际截图与参考包对比

say.text: 这个 TUI 的边框或宽字符列有没有错位?跑视觉 QA
say.note: 会跑 tui-check 的宽度与边框检查

howto.what_en: After you build or change a UI, it captures screenshots as evidence, dispatches two read-only reviewer subagents in parallel, then gives one good/bad verdict. Covers web, terminal TUI, and paginated documents.
howto.when_en: Fires after any UI build or change, before calling it done, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Not for surfaces with no rendered output.

say_en.text: Check if this page renders right, with screenshot evidence and a verdict
say_en.note: Captures shots, runs two reviewers, returns a verdict

say_en.text: Run visual QA against the mock for this component
say_en.note: Compares actual capture to the reference packet

say_en.text: Is this TUI's border alignment or wide-char columns broken? Run visual QA
say_en.note: Runs the tui-check width and border test
